instruction: Configure rsyslog to listen on UDP port 514
Forward all logs to a remote syslog server via UDP
Create a custom rsyslog template for log format
Configure rsyslog queue for reliability
output: echo 'module(load="imuxsock")' > /etc/rsyslog.d/queue.conf && echo 'ruleset(name="forward") { action(type="omfwd" target="192.168.1.100" port="514" protocol="udp" queue.type="linkedlist" queue.size="10000") }' >> /etc/rsyslog.d/queue.conf

instruction: Set up syslog-ng source for UDP
Create a syslog-ng destination to forward logs
Define a syslog-ng log path from source to destination
Validate syslog-ng configuration
Test rsyslog configuration for syntax errors
Write a specific application log to a separate file with rsyslog
Configure syslog-ng to filter by facility
Set up rsyslog TLS forwarding to remote server
output: echo 'global(DefaultNetstreamDriver="gtls")' > /etc/rsyslog.d/tls.conf && echo 'action(type="omfwd" protocol="tcp" target="192.168.1.100" port="6514" StreamDriver="gtls" StreamDriverMode="1")' >> /etc/rsyslog.d/tls.conf

instruction: Configure rsyslog to ignore kernel messages
Create a syslog-ng template for JSON output
Configure rsyslog disk queue for buffer persistence
output: echo 'action(type="omfwd" target="192.168.1.100" port="514" protocol="tcp" queue.type="disk" queue.filename="forward" queue.maxdiskspace="1g" queue.saveonshutdown="on")' > /etc/rsyslog.d/disk_queue.conf

instruction: Reload rsyslog configuration after changes
Reload syslog-ng configuration after changes
Discard debug messages in syslog-ng
output: echo 'filter f_debug { level(debug); };' >> /etc/syslog-ng/conf.d/debug_filter.conf && echo 'log { source(s_sys); filter(f_debug); };' >> /etc/syslog-ng/conf.d/debug_discard.conf

instruction: Configure rsyslog to use MySQL output module
output: echo 'module(load="ommysql")' > /etc/rsyslog.d/mysql.conf && echo 'action(type="ommysql" server="localhost" db="Syslog" uid="rsyslog" pwd="password")' >> /etc/rsyslog.d/mysql.conf

instruction: Set up rsyslog rate limiting
Create syslog-ng configuration for TCP source
Configure rsyslog to send Cisco IOS logs to separate file
Enable rsyslog debug mode for troubleshooting
Set syslog-ng log rotation by size
output: echo 'options { log_fifo_size(2048); };' >> /etc/syslog-ng/conf.d/options.conf && echo 'destination d_local { file("/var/log/messages" log-fifo-size(5000)); };' >> /etc/syslog-ng/conf.d/local_dest.conf

instruction: Configure rsyslog with multiple action queues
output: echo 'action(name="mainq" type="omfwd" target="192.168.1.100" port="514" protocol="tcp" queue.type="linkedlist" queue.size="50000")' > /etc/rsyslog.d/multi_queue.conf
